title: Swedenborg's visits to other planets

tellings.quote: >> 17th century Swedish mystic Emanuel Swedenborg you know saying he went to other planets and coming back

plain: The Swedish mystic Emanuel Swedenborg said he travelled to other planets and came back, Michels recalls. Michels brings it up himself, placing Swedenborg in the 17th century, in a talk with a former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, who was trained as a psychic spy. He offers Swedenborg as an early case of someone claiming the mind can travel far beyond the body.
